messages.content: Do you think nostalgia is mostly a good feeling or does it hold people back?
Both, I think it depends on whether someone visits nostalgia or lives there. What brought this up for you?
I've been thinking a lot about an old relationship lately, more than usual.

Is it the actual relationship you miss, or more the version of yourself you were back then? Those are pretty different things to be nostalgic for, and figuring out which one it is usually clarifies what you actually need right now.
